---
pagetitle: "Bimandra Djaafara"
title: "Publications"
toc: false
include-after-body:
  text: |
    <script>
    window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
      const headings = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('h2')).filter(h =>
        /^\d{4}$/.test(h.textContent.trim())
      );
      if (!headings.length) return;
      const nav = document.createElement('nav');
      nav.className = 'year-nav';
      const label = document.createElement('div');
      label.className = 'year-nav-label';
      label.textContent = 'Year';
      nav.appendChild(label);
      const links = headings.map(h => {
        if (!h.id) h.id = 'year-' + h.textContent.trim();
        const a = document.createElement('a');
        a.href = '#' + h.id;
        a.textContent = h.textContent.trim();
        a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          h.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
        });
        nav.appendChild(a);
        return { a: a, h: h };
      });
      document.body.appendChild(nav);
      const obs = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
        entries.forEach(function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            links.forEach(function (l) { l.a.classList.remove('active'); });
            var match = links.find(function (l) { return l.h === entry.target; });
            if (match) match.a.classList.add('active');
          }
        });
      }, { rootMargin: '-10% 0px -80% 0px' });
      headings.forEach(function (h) { obs.observe(h); });
    });
    </script>

```{r pubs}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

library(RefManageR)

BibOptions(check.entries = FALSE)
bib <- ReadBib("publications.bib", .Encoding = "UTF-8", check = "warn")
bib <- sort(bib, sorting = "ydnt")

# Strip LaTeX curly braces used for capitalisation protection
clean <- function(s) gsub("[{}]", "", as.character(s))

# Format authors as "Family I. I." abbreviation style
fmt_authors <- function(author_obj) {
  n <- length(author_obj)
  out <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    p      <- author_obj[i]
    fam    <- paste(clean(if (!is.null(p$family) && length(p$family) > 0) p$family else ""), collapse = " ")
    giv    <- paste(clean(if (!is.null(p$given)  && length(p$given)  > 0) p$given  else ""), collapse = " ")
    parts  <- strsplit(trimws(giv), "\\s+")[[1]]
    parts  <- parts[nchar(parts) > 0]
    inits  <- if (length(parts) > 0) paste(paste0(substr(parts, 1, 1), "."), collapse = " ") else ""
    trimws(paste(fam, inits))
  }, character(1))
  paste(out, collapse = ", ")
}

highlight <- function(s) {
  s <- gsub("Djaafara B\\. A\\.", "<strong>Djaafara BA</strong>", s)
  s <- gsub("Djaafara B\\.",     "<strong>Djaafara B</strong>",  s)
  s
}

all_years <- sort(unique(sapply(bib, function(e) e$year)), decreasing = TRUE)

for (yr in all_years) {
  cat(paste0("\n\n## ", yr, "\n\n"))

  for (key in names(bib)) {
    e <- bib[[key]]
    if (e$year != yr) next

    title <- clean(e$title)

    doi   <- if (!is.null(e$doi)) clean(e$doi) else ""
    url   <- if (!is.null(e$url)) clean(e$url) else ""
    doi_clean <- gsub("^https?://doi\\.org/", "", doi)
    link  <- if (nchar(doi_clean) > 0) paste0("https://doi.org/", doi_clean) else url

    title_html <- if (nchar(link) > 0) {
      paste0('<a href="', link, '">', title, "</a>")
    } else title

    authors_html <- highlight(fmt_authors(e$author))

    journal <- if (!is.null(e$journal))   clean(e$journal)   else
               if (!is.null(e$publisher)) clean(e$publisher) else ""

    note  <- if (!is.null(e$note)) clean(e$note) else ""
    badge <- if (grepl("[Pp]reprint", note)) ' <span class="preprint-badge">Preprint</span>' else ""

    doi_link <- if (nchar(doi_clean) > 0) {
      paste0(' · <a class="pub-doi" href="https://doi.org/', doi_clean, '">', doi_clean, "</a>")
    } else ""

    cat(paste0(
      '<div class="pub-entry">\n',
      '  <div class="pub-title">',   title_html,   "</div>\n",
      '  <div class="pub-authors">', authors_html, "</div>\n",
      '  <div class="pub-venue"><em>', journal, "</em>", doi_link, badge, "</div>\n",
      "</div>\n\n"
    ))
  }
}
```
